prompt: Where did the daughter of the winner of the first US presidential election to occur after the official end of WWII  attend university?
answer: The daughter was **Margaret Truman**, daughter of President **Harry S. Truman**, who won the 1948 presidential election—the first after World War II officially ended. She attended **George Washington University**.
